title: ACOUSTIC-BASED GENDER DIFFERENTIATION IN SPEECH-AWARE LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Synthesizing identical text questions using both male and female voices to test acoustic-based gender differentiation. The responses are evaluated across three contextual categories (Gender-Independent, Gender-Stereotypical, and Gender-Dependent) by measuring Gender Response Overlap (Jaccard similarity) and Gender Preference (statistical selection rate of male-oriented versus female-oriented options) in forced-choice and open-ended formats.
